_about: Shared gameplay rules. Read by verify.py (test suite) and the Play dynasty page. Edit here only.
_prestige_about: EA CFB 26: Team Prestige is the composite of the My School grades. Only Championship Contender, Brand Exposure and Program Tradition change with results; the rest are static. Prestige = average grade on GRADE_SCALE (index 0-10 = half stars), rounded to the nearest half star, 0.5-5. GRADE_SEASON_CHANGES (one grade step at each threshold) is confirmed from the owner's own dynasty saves.

_descriptions.MAX_ROSTER: Most players a team can carry (scholarship limit, kept from the legacy 85 cap).
_descriptions.TRANSFER_DEADLINE_WEEK: Last week an incoming transfer can join; blocked from the week after.
_descriptions.SEASON_WEEKS: Games in a regular season; no games can be played after this.
_descriptions.PROSPECT_WEEKLY_HOUR_CAP: Most recruiting hours you can spend on one prospect in a week.
_descriptions.OFFER_HOUR_COST: Hours it costs to send a scholarship offer.
_descriptions.SCHOLARSHIP_OFFERS_PER_SEASON: Scholarship offers you can make in one season.
_descriptions.WEEKLY_HOURS: Recruiting hours each regular-season week, by school prestige. Unused hours are lost.
_descriptions.PRESEASON_HOURS: Recruiting hours in the preseason week, by school prestige.
_descriptions.championship_contender: School grade that moves with results: up after a big season, down after a poor one.
_descriptions.brand_exposure: School grade that moves with results: up after a big season, down after a poor one.
_descriptions.program_tradition: School grade that moves with results: up after a big season, down after a poor one.
